title: Add due dates to action items
analysis: Action items are more useful when they carry a due date. The skill should ask for one when it is missing from the notes instead of leaving it out.

instructionEdits.content:
1. Summary: Two or three sentences capturing the purpose and outcome of the meeting.
  2. Decisions: A bulleted list of decisions that were made.
  3. Action items: A bulleted list of tasks, each with an owner and a due date. If the notes do not mention a due date, mark it as TBD and ask the user for it.

title: Clarify when to use the skill
analysis: The agent-facing description should tell agents that the skill also handles call transcripts and Slack threads, so it gets picked up in those situations.

agentFacingDescriptionEdit.content: Turns raw meeting notes, call transcripts or Slack threads into a structured summary with decisions and action items (with owners and due dates).

title: Hand over skill maintenance to Leila
analysis: Leila now runs the weekly team meetings and should be able to maintain the skill. Luke no longer attends them and asked to be removed.
